samaveda_hymn3.introduction: The Soma decades form the largest section of the Purvarchika and contain hymns dedicated to the sacred Soma ritual drink.
samaveda_hymn3.scripture_text: A representative Samavedic hymn passage for Hymn 3, expressing melodic devotion, sacred recitation, and meditative harmony.
samaveda_hymn3.philosophical_explanation: Soma represents divine inspiration and spiritual ecstasy. The musical worship of Soma through Samagana was believed to generate the highest forms of spiritual experience accessible through ritual practice.
